issuer.summary: Issuer 6.5 retained provisionally pending Hastra holder-rights and assurance reassessment. Current September 23 terms identify Signum Ltd. and its disclosed parent Provenance Cayman Foundation, recognize pooled proprietary backing interests and impose specified restoration/recordkeeping obligations. These documentary accountability positives are not independent proof of corporate control, effective segregation, holder standing or perfected collateral priority. Full lender/pool schedules, trust/agency acknowledgments and liability carveout interpretation remain unresolved. FCC registration/KPMG audits support upstream FCC disclosure only and do not validate Hastra wrapper liabilities or credit recoveries. Old FCC-only, code-audit and freeze-power Issuer rationale withdrawn; contract powers stay on Contract & Admin and credit quality on Backing. Equal provisional Hastra marks reflect shared operator/rights gaps, not automatic inheritance or a common FCC guarantee.
issuer.summary_source: September 23 Hastra terms checked in current public application November 4; FCC prospectus with August 6 supplement; Figure November 2 Prime terms. Documentary scope only; historical financial/security clocks are not renewed.
facts: Section 2E recognizes pooled proprietary backing rights and specified Signum restoration obligations; enforceability, actual lender records, segregation and collateral priority remain unresolved.
wYLDS backing permits direct certificates plus deployed YLDS lender interests/receivables and recoveries; PRIME documents HELOC lending. Neither is universally idle FCC certificates.
Figure group, FCC, Signum and Provenance Cayman Foundation are separate roles; direct FCC record-holder rights and KPMG assurance do not automatically transfer to Hastra holders.
Pool regimes/schedules determine agent and recovery rights; broad liability clauses coexist with proprietary-right carveouts and require legal review.
No new authority/loan-performance/capacity verification; current multisignature/continuity text does not override older security observations.
issuer.producer_note: Authored source is riskAnalyst internal report, not TIDR. Prior FCC-only scoring rationale withdrawn; historical FCC financial facts remain in Figure report at their old source clocks, not this current Hastra issuer judgment. No automatic publication of private profiles.
